title: July 12, 2011: A Bright Limb Prominence from Solar Dynamics Observatory
source_institution: NASA Goddard Scientific Visualization Studio (SDO/AIA data)
credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, the SDO Science Team, and the Virtual Solar Observatory
license: Public domain (NASA SVS FAQ: content is public domain unless otherwise noted; none noted on this page); credit given as requested on the page
observatory_instrument: Solar Dynamics Observatory, Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA)
band: Extreme ultraviolet, AIA 304 Angstrom filter (30.4 nm)
image_kind: single-filter extreme-ultraviolet image shown with a colour table (false colour; EUV light is invisible to the eye)
processing_notes: Still frame (frame 400) from the SVS visualization; no further processing by this project.
